method: Independent direct arithmetic over raw result matrices/curves, raw per-update allocations, event reset identities, and final trusted local checkpoints. No project metric, selection, summarizer, or inventory computation helper was invoked.
limitations: This is a numerical/provenance audit, not an independent rerun of training or a measurement of generalization to natural images.
Three evaluation seeds and a development-chosen procedural benchmark are exploratory. All intervals are unadjusted and do not support a confirmatory efficacy claim.

For three seed pairs the exact 95% percentile-bootstrap endpoints are the smallest and largest observed seed effects; this agrees with the logged 10000-resample intervals and exposes their limited information.
Acquisition AUC combines existing knowledge and learning during the first 256 current presentations; no scratch adjustment or pure-plasticity interpretation is used.
Stationary performance is near ceiling. Fixed-pool drawdown uses only experiences 10,20,...,100 and can miss intervening or untested-pool damage.
The 0.1 cap is verified from logged optimizer displacement norms and frozen code semantics; it excludes structural reset mutations and does not bound prediction changes.
Nominal feature gain matching occurs before global clipping. Actual displacement, classifier effects, and compute need not match.
Pairing checks compare logged whole-stream tensor fingerprints and actual final replay tensors/RNG states; the full rendering stream was not regenerated by this audit.
Current file coverage, hashes, and git/filesystem timestamps cannot reconstruct deleted attempts or provide independent trusted-clock proof of historical locking.
Single-component versus baseline comparisons plus the combined condition do not identify every component interaction or conditional mechanism effect.
